Reasoning: This stage keeps the current panda_fingertip world-frame pose fixed while establishing a real grasp on the can. freeze_position encodes holding the fingertip origin at its stage-start position within 0.01 m. freeze_orientation encodes holding the stage-start orientation within 5 degrees. object_grasped is used instead of close_gripper because the requirement is not merely mechanical closure but a firm physical grasp of the can. Symmetric finger velocity control, bilateral gripper joint-state monitoring, and stable finger-effort-based stopping are not directly representable in the available constraint API; the successful grasp condition is represented by object_grasped, and the fixed-pose abort thresholds are represented by the freeze constraints.
